title: Task file frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block of a vault/05-tasks/**/*.md task file. The validator in scripts/validate-agent-system.py implements this schema with the standard library (no external jsonschema dependency); this file is the documented contract.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier, e.g. TASK-000, TASK-042. Must be unique across the whole vault/05-tasks/ tree.

owner.description: Exactly one owner. Must be a single agent name or human identifier, not a list.

reviewer.description: Required (non-empty) once status reaches qa-review or later.

dependencies.description: Task IDs this task depends on. Must reference existing task files and must not form a cycle.

$comment: Valid lifecycle transitions enforced by the validator, not expressible in pure JSON Schema: draft->ready->active->blocked->implementation-complete->qa-review->changes-requested->approved->released, with changes-requested->active and blocked->active also allowed. Any other transition is a violation.
